name: Tiv Taam Holdings 1 Ltd.
summary: Tiv Taam Holdings 1 Ltd. produces, markets, and imports of food products in Israel. The company offers fruits and vegetables; meat and chicken products; fish and sea fruit; eggs, milk, and salads; breads and pastries; canned food pasta dressing and spreads; nuts, seeds, snacks, dried fruits; and cereal snacks and sweets, such as granola and muesli, oats, energy bars, halva, chocolate and candy, snacks, and cakes and cookies.
